title: Compat API v1.53: image Identity and events application/jsonl
body:
Docker Engine API [v1.53](https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version-history/#v153-api-changes) still has two Compat gaps before we can treat 1.53 as covered under the parent epic (claim v1.55).
## Needs work
### 1. Events `application/jsonl`
- Negotiate `Accept: application/jsonl` in addition to v1.52 `application/x-ndjson` and `application/json-seq`.
- Can land with or immediately after the v1.52 events Accept work; reference that issue if split.
### 2. `GET /images/{name}/json` `Identity`
- Populate trusted identity/origin (`Signature` / `Pull` / `Build`) when available.
- Today Compat image inspect never sets `Identity`.
## Checklist
- [ ] Events `application/jsonl` content-type negotiation
- [ ] Image inspect `Identity`
## Out of scope / N/A
- `GET /info` `NRI`: leave unset unless/until Podman integrates NRI
- Legacy `/system/df` fields: already omitted for >= 1.52 clients
- Deprecate `/grpc` and `/session`: informational only
## Contributing
If you want to work on one checklist item, please open a focused issue (or PR) for that part and reference **this** issue (and the parent epic). Prefer one change area per PR.
## References
- https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version-history/#v153-api-changes
